name: Ichiki Sousuke
source:
A close friend to Kikusui Ayato.

[spoiler]He had been forced by his father since childhood to help him with Nishikata Hospital's secret time leaping research. He eventually tried to help his friend Kikusui Ayato to stop the research.[/spoiler]
